notes.account: The continuing paragraph says that pursuing the resistance à fleur de peau leads to generalizing and deepening the notion of homotopy type. The next paragraph switches to sheaves of sets or modules on the étale topos of a scheme X, calls locally constant sheaves the simplest constructible sheaves subject to an additional finiteness condition, and describes constructibility through a finite partition into locally closed constructible cells or strata. It then says the category of constructible sheaves recovers all sheaves by passing to ind-objects and appears as an inductive limit of categories associated with partitions; the sentence continues off this page.
notes.author_uncertainty: No explicit question or doubt is stated on this page. The phrases “modulo une condition de finitude supplémentaire assez anodine” and “(plus une condition de finitude...)” leave that condition unspecified; they are the author’s qualifications, not a proof or a precise definition supplied by this reader.
